text:
incident-bot: ALERT: GPU pool saturation detected in eu-west-1 for service=redwood-runtime. Trigger: queue_length > 1200 across pools; autoscaler failed to add capacity (max_pools hit). Suspected root after v31 model rollout: increased prefix/kv warmup. link: https://grafana/redwood/alert/1748880000 :rotating_light:

kevin (oncall): seeing same in logs, p95 latency jumped. paging sasha, maria.

sasha (eng-sre): on it. quick check — autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts blocked by policy max_pools=12. pools at 12/12 and queue per-pool ~100-150.

maria (runtime): v31 rollout started 2:12 UTC, we pushed tokenizer/prefill optimization. early hypothesis: longer effective context + kvcache misses causing prefill amplification.

alex (prod-sd): customers? any 5xx spike?

kevin (oncall): yes, several customers reporting timeouts. 5xx rate up ~8% for the last 10m; some higher-tier customers hit degraded responses.

pm_tom (product): flagging to support. Which customers impacted most?

maria (runtime): quick metric dump:
```
metric: gpu_pool_count=12 (max configured)
metric: avg_queue_length_total=1200
metric: per_pool_queue=[130,145,120,110,100,95,140,150,110,100,120,85]
metric: p95_latency_ms=2200 (was 320ms baseline)
metric: kv_cache_miss_rate=0.67 (v30 baseline 0.18)
```

sasha (eng-sre): ok. immediate mitigations: 1) pause rollout and revert traffic to v30 2) temporarily increase max_pools + emergency quota 3) rate-limit prefill-heavy routes. Which one is quickest?

kevin (oncall): #1 and #3 are fastest. Reverting rollout should stop new warmups. We can apply a rate-limit rule to /chat/prefill and /stream endpoints to cut prefill volume by ~50% while we scale.

maria (runtime): initiating rollback now. rolling back canary to v30. kick: `/deploy rollback v31 --canary` (executed).

incident-bot: Deployment event: rollback v31 -> v30 started by maria at 1748880075.

alex (prod-sd): I'll open a high-touch support thread for affected accounts and notify SLAs. Short note: some customers might see 502s for up to ~5-10m during rollback.

sasha (eng-sre): applying rate-limit rule (temporary):
```json
{ "route": "/chat/prefill", "limit": "50r/s", "scope": "global", "reason": "prefill mitigation" }
```
applied at 1748880120

kevin (oncall): confirming autoscaler attempts. sasha do we have permission to bump max_pools to 16 temporarily?

sasha (eng-sre): I don't want to increase pool count without quota; but vendor quota is available if we request emergency increase. Filing request now to infra-vendor and enabling warmup-burst gating.

maria (runtime): rollback is at 30% traffic already. kv_cache_miss_rate trending down in canary logs. prefill volume dropped ~40% so queue length reduced to ~700.

pm_tom (product): update for support — partial restoration expected within 10m, we'll know more after rollback completes.

alex (prod-sd): notifying top 5 customers now, using template: "We're mitigating a capacity issue caused by a recent model rollout; we've rolled back the change and are applying traffic controls. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline."

sasha (eng-sre): infra vendor responded: emergency pool quota approved to 16 but provisioning ETA ~12m. keeping it as a fallback.

kevin (oncall): handoff in 20m to sasha for incident watch. I'll annotate the incident timeline and current mitigations in the ticket.

maria (runtime): rollback reached 100% at 1748880360. post-rollback metrics:
```
metric: avg_queue_length_total=220
metric: p95_latency_ms=480ms
metric: kv_cache_miss_rate=0.21
metric: 5xx_rate=1.2%
```

pm_tom (product): great, can we confirm no data loss and no customer-level degradations remain?

maria (runtime): no data loss. some requests retried; SDKs should have idempotency. we'll keep scaling windows open and monitor for regression on next rollout.

sasha (eng-sre): next steps: 1) postmortem with timeline and rollout gating (prewarm tests + kvcache simulation) 2) update autoscaler to allow temporary surge pools for warmup events 3) add a rollout kill-switch that blocks model changes when pool_util > 80% 4) include prefill route throttles in default rate-limits.

kevin (oncall): handing off to sasha for monitoring and postmortem lead. cc @pm_tom @alex. I'm available if escalation needed. :white_check_mark:

sasha (eng-sre): taking handoff. leaving a watch page and will coordinate postmortem. final note: root cause looks like v31 increased effective context due to tokenizer change + higher kv cache miss amplification during prefill. we'll coordinate with model team to add explicit kvcache warmup or smaller canaries in future.

incident-bot: NOTE: Incident severity P2. Auto-created ticket #INC-1748880000.

kevin (oncall): closing pager. moving to incident tracking in JIRA; status: mitigated -> monitoring. last update at 1748881200.
